analysis.one_line_summary: Creator demonstrates styling a bouncy 90s bob blowout using the Wavytalk thermal round brush.
analysis.full_description: The video starts with a brief flash of the finished voluminous bouncy bob, followed by a close-up of the lavender Wavytalk thermal round brush (Blowout Boost). The creator then sections her hair and demonstrates step-by-step how she curls under each section, including the back layers and front bangs, ending with running her fingers through the full, bouncy, voluminous blowout. Text overlays highlight achieving the perfect blowout and a price under $45.

on_screen_text.text: Getting the most perfect blowout look every single time with this brush

scenes.visual: Creator facing camera tossing her finished bouncy styled hair with her hand.
Creator holds the purple Wavytalk thermal round brush upright toward the camera.
Creator styling the lower side section of her hair using the thermal brush.
scenes.action: Curling the ends inward and releasing a polished bounce.

scenes.visual: Hair tied up in a half-up bun; creator styles lower back section.
scenes.action: Brushes and rolls under the bottom layer of hair.

scenes.visual: Creator curls side hair strand around the barrel close to her face.

scenes.action: Twirling hair through the hot round brush for volume.

scenes.visual: Creator working on top bang section directly over her forehead.
scenes.action: Rolls front bangs backward over the brush to create volume.

scenes.visual: Creator holding the brush and touching up the curled front bangs.

scenes.visual: Creator runs both hands through her completed voluminous 90s blowout bob.
